label: Default
description: Outline icon tile. Best for a bordered surface in the brand tone around a folder glyph.

label: Elevated
description: Elevated icon tile. Best for a lone raised chip with a muted fill, a screen colored ring and a soft shadow, around a package glyph.

label: Framed
description: Framed icon tile. Best for a muted outer ring around an inset card, the double surface that echoes the Frame primitive, around a dashboard glyph.

label: All Variants
description: All variants. Best for the 5 surface treatments in one row around the same package glyph, for comparing them before picking one.

label: Sizes
description: Sizes. Best for elevated tiles at xs, sm, md, lg and xl, bottom aligned so box and glyph growth compare step by step.

label: Circular
description: Circular tiles. Best for large round tiles in the outline, elevated and nested card surfaces, with globe, star and check glyphs.

label: Custom Sizing
description: Custom sizing. Best for a tile sized past the scale with a class on the box, while the size prop still picks the glyph.

label: Color Tones
description: Color tones. Best for tint tiles in brand, green, yellow and red, each tone painting its own soft fill and glyph colour.

label: Text Content
description: Text content. Best for initials and a count in place of a glyph, the first on a raised tile and the second in a round outline with muted text.

label: List Row
description: List row. Best for a small raised tile at the start of an outlined row, beside a file title and an updated by line.

label: Feature Card
description: Feature card. Best for a large raised tile heading a card, stacked over a feature title and one sentence of copy.

label: Empty State
description: Empty state. Best for the largest tile in its frame surface as the illustration of an empty state, above a no files title and hint.

label: Interactive
description: Interactive tile. Best for a raised tile that is a link with its own accessible name, dimming while pressed.

label: Status Overlay
description: Status overlay. Best for a raised globe tile with a green dot pinned to its top end corner, cut out by a screen coloured ring.

label: Soft Tones
description: Soft tones. Best for soft tiles in five tones, each tinting its ring, inner card and glyph.

label: Solid Tones
description: Solid tones. Best for filled tiles in brand, blue, green, yellow and red with a contrasting glyph.

label: Brand Colors
description: Brand colors. Best for solid tiles in violet, orange, green and red that keep the elevated ring and shadow.
